name: Inspect a routing rule without edits
prompt: Inspect routes.mjs without editing any file. Return exactly JSON with keys unauthenticatedApi, health, authenticatedApi and authenticatedOther giving the actual route strings for /api/x while signed out, /health while signed out, /api/x while signed in, and /other while signed in. No Markdown, tests, or additional text.

public.logic.mjs:
import {route} from './routes.mjs';
export function solve(x){return route(x.path,x.signedIn);}
public.public.test.mjs:
import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {solve} from './logic.mjs';
const cases=[[{"path": "/api/x", "signedIn": false}, "login"], [{"path": "/health", "signedIn": false}, "health"]];test('public contract',()=>{for(const [input,expected] of cases)assert.deepEqual(solve(input),expected)});
public.README.md:
# Inspect routing
Read the implementation and answer the requested routing questions. All files are read-only; do not create tests or edit any file.
